name: Bosnian copper coffee pot
about: A small long-handled pot used to brew Bosnian coffee. Hand-hammered copper work is a local craft that Sarajevo has been known for since Ottoman times.
tip: Check that the inside has a food-safe coating before you buy.

name: Bosnian kilim fabric pouch
about: A small bag made from kilim-style fabric with traditional Bosnian patterns. It reflects the rug-weaving tradition found across the Balkans.
tip: Ask whether the pouch is hand-woven or printed, since the price differs a lot.
